verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Asana API tokens can be created ("create and authorize with a token") and MCP apps registered in the developer console, but nothing documents scoping or restricting those credentials to least privilege. The "scoped permissions" claim covers Asana's own in-product AI Teammates governed from the admin console. That is an adjacent feature, not issuing scoped API credentials to an external agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
